Introduction

Kota is a South Korean singer. She is a former member of the girl group Sunny Hill and a member of the disbanded project froup WSG Wannabe and it's unit OASISO.

Following Sunny Hill's change of labels to Nega Network in 2010, the agency announced Kota would be joining the group as a new member. She made her official debut as a member of the group on June 9, 2011 with the mini album "Midnight Circus".
